1.1: Hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel nachri, vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay, vehammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo vekabbala, patur min habbechora, shenneemar (Bamidbar 3), beyisrael, aval lo vaacherim. kohanim uleviyyim peturin mikkal vachomer, im patru shel yisrael bammidbar, din hu sheyyifteru shel atzman:
1.2: Para sheyyalda kemin chamor, vachamor sheyyalda kemin sus, patur min habbechora, shenneemar peter chamor peter chamor, shene feamim, ad sheyyehe hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor. uma hem baachila. behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea, muttar baachila. utemea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora, asur baachila, shehayyotze mehattame, tame. vehayyotze min hattahor, tahor. dag tame shebbala dag tahor, muttar baachila. vetahor shebbala dag tame, asur baachila, lefi sheeno giddulav:
1.3: Chamor shello vikkera, veyalda shene zecharim, noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva, mafrish tale echad leatzmo. shete chamorim shello vikkeru, veyaldu shene zecharim, noten shene telayim lakkohen. zachar unekeva, o shene zecharim unekeva, noten tale echad lakkohen. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum:
1.4: Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim, noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva, mafrish tale echad leatzmo, shenneemar (Shemot led), ufeter chamor tifde vese, min hakkevasim umin haizzim, zachar unekeva, gadol vekatan, tamim uvaal mum. ufode vo peamim harebe. nichnas laddir lehitasser. veim met, nehenim bo:
1.5: En podim lo vaegel, velo vachayya, velo vashshechuta, velo vatterefa, velo vakkilayim, velo vakkoy. rabbi elazar mattir bakkilayim mippene shehu se, veoser bakkoy mippene shehu safek. netano lakkohen, en hakkohen rashshay lekayyemo ad sheyyafrish se tachtav:
1.6: Hammafrish pidyon peter chamor umet, rabbi eliezer omer, chayyavin beacharayuto, kachamesh selaim shel ben. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavin beacharayuto, kefidyon maaser sheni. heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi tzadok al pidyon peter chamor shemmet, sheen kan lakkohen kelum. met peter chamor, rabbi eliezer omer, yikkaver, umuttar bahanaato shel tale. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich lehikkaver, vehattale lakkohen:
1.7: Lo ratza lifdoto, orfo vekofitz meacharav vekovro. mitzvat pediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa, shenneemar (Shemot 13), veim lo tifde vaarafto. mitzvat yeida kodemet lemitzvat pediyya, shenneemar (sham 21), asher lo yeadah vehefdah. mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza, barishona, shehayu mitkavvenin leshem mitzva. veachshav sheen mitkavvenin leshem mitzva, amru mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum. mitzvat geulla baadon hu kodem lechol adam, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim lo yiggael venimkar beerkech:

2.1: Hallokeach ubbar parato shel nachri, vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay, hammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo vekabbala, patur min habbechora, shenneemar (Bamidbar 3), beyisrael, aval lo vaacherim. kohanim uleviyyim chayyavin. lo nifteru mibbechor behema tehora, (velo nifteru) ella mippidyon habben umippeter chamor:
2.2: Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan, venifdu, chayyavim babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin liggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osim temura, veim metu yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser:
2.3: Kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua (venifdu), peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin liggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav, veosin temura, veim metu yikkaveru:
2.4: Hamekabbel tzon barzel min hannachri, veladot peturin, uvalde veladot chayyavin. heemid veladot tachat immotehem, valde veladot feturin, uvalde valde veladot chayyavin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, afillu ad asara dorot, peturin, sheacharayutan lannachri:
2.5: Rachel sheyyalda kemin ez, veez sheyyalda kemin rachel, patur min habbechora. veim yesh bo miktzat simanin, chayyav:
2.6: Rachel shello vikkera veyalda shene zecharim veyatzu shene rashehen keechad, rabbi yose haggelili omer, shenehen lakkohen. shenneemar (Shemot 13), hazzecharim laAdonai. vachachamim omrim, i efshar, ella echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenim benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:
2.7: Shete rechelot shello vikkeru, veyaldu shene zecharim, noten shenehem lakkohen. zachar unekeva, hazzachar lakkohen. shene zecharim unekeva, echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenim benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. shete nekevot vezachar, o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum:
2.8: Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim, echad lo veechad lakkohen. rabbi tarfon omer, hakkohen borer lo et hayyafe. rabbi akiva omer, meshammenin benehen, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev. vechayyav bammattanot. rabbi yose poter, shehaya rabbi yose omer, kol shechalifav beyad kohen, patur min hamattanot. rabbi meir mechayyev. met echad mehen, rabbi tarfon omer, yachaloku. rabbi akiva omer, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:
2.9: Yotze dofen vehabba acharav, rabbi tarfon omer, shenehem yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu vemuman labbealim. rabbi akiva omer, shenehen enan bechor, harishon mishshum sheeno feter rechem, vehashsheni mishshum shekkiddemo acher:

3.1: Hallokeach behema min hannachri veen yadua im bikkera veim lo vikkera, rabbi yishmael omer, ez bat shenatah vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. rachel bat shetayim vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. para vachamor benot shalosh vadday lakkohen, mikkan veelach safek. amar lo rabbi akiva, illu bavvalad bilvad behema nifteret, haya chidvarecha, ella amru, siman havvalad bivhema dakka, tinuf. uvegassa, shilya. uveishsha, shefir veshilya. ze hakkelal, kol sheyadua shebbikkera, en kan lakkohen kelum. vechol shello vikkera, hare ze lakkohen. im safek, yeachel bemumo labbealim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam, hare zo tikkaver, veniftera min habbechora:
3.2: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hallokeach behema menika min hannachri, eno choshesh shemma venah shel acheret haya. nichnas letoch edro veraa et hammavkirot menikot veet sheenan mavkirot menikot, eno choshesh shemma venah shel zo ba lo etzel zo, o shemma venah shel zo ba lo etzel zo:
3.3: Rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, hashshochet et habbechor, ose makom bekofitz mikkan umikkan vetolesh hassear, uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo. vechen hattolesh et hassear lirot mekom hammum:
3.4: Sear bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho vachallon veachar kach shechato, akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin, divre rabbi yehuda. amar rabbi yose, lo vaze hittir akavya, ella visar bechor baal mum shennashar vehinnicho bachallon veachar kach met, baze akavya ben mahalalel mattir, vachachamim osrin. hatztzemer hameduvlal babbechor, et shehu nire min haggizza, muttar. veet sheeno nire min haggizza, asur:

4.1: Ad kamma yisrael chayyavim lehittappel babbechor. bivhema dakka, ad sheloshim yom. uvaggassa, chamishshim yom. rabbi yose omer, baddakka shelosha chodashim. amar lo hakkohen betoch zeman ze tenehu li, hare ze lo yitteno lo. im haya vaal mum, amar lo ten li sheochlennu, muttar. uvishat hammikdash, im haya tamim, amar lo ten li sheakrivennu, muttar. habbechor neechol shana veshana ben tamim ben baal mum, shenneemar (Devarim 15), lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana:
4.2: Nolad lo mum betoch shenato, muttar lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. leachar shenato, eno rashshay lekayyemo ella ad sheloshim yom:
4.3: Hashshochet habbechor umare et mumo, rabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi meir omer, hoil vehu nishchat shello al pi mumche, asur:
4.4: Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv, hare ze yikkaver, vishallem mibbeto. dan et haddin, zikka et hachayyav vechiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hatahor vetiher et hattame, ma sheasa asuy vishallem mibbeto. veim haya mumche levet din, patur milleshallem. maase vefara shennittela haem shellah, veheechilah rabbi tarfon lakkelavim, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruha. amar todos harofe, en para vachazira yotza mealekkesanderiyya ad shehem chotchin et haem shellah, bishvil shello teled. amar rabbi tarfon, halcha chamorcha tarfon. amar lo rabbi akiva, rabbi tarfon, patur atta, sheatta mumche levet din, vechol hammumche levet din patur milleshallem:
4.5: Hannotel secharo lihyot roe vechorot, en shochatin al piv, ella im ken haya mumche keila veyavne, shehittiru lo chachamim lihyot notel arbaa issarot bivhema dakka, veshishsha baggassa, ben tamim ben baal mum:
4.6: Hannotel secharo ladun, dinav betelim. lehaid, edutav betelin. lehazzot ulekaddesh, memav me meara veefro efer mikle. im haya chohen vetimmeahu mitterumato, maachilo umashko vesacho. veim haya zaken, markivo al hachamor. venoten lo secharo kappoel:
4.7: Hechashud al habbechorot, en lokchin mimmennu besar tzevaim velo orot sheenan avudin. rabbi eliezer omer, lokchim mimmennu orot shel nekeva, veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer mellubban vetzoi, aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy uvegadim:
4.8: Hechashud al hasheviit en lokchin mimmennu fishtan vaafillu serek, aval lokchin mimmennu tavuy vearig:
4.9: Hechashud lihyot mocher teruma leshem chullin, en lokchin mimmennu afillu mayim o melach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheyyesh bo zikkat terumot umaasrot, en lokchin mimmennu:
4.10: Hechashud al hashsheviit, eno chashud al hammaasrot. hechashud al hammaasrot, eno chashud al hashsheviit. hechashud al ze veal ze, chashud al hattohorot. veyesh shehu chashud al hattohorot, veeno chashud lo al ze velo al ze. ze hakkelal, kol hechashud al haddavar, lo dano velo meido:

5.1: Kol pesule hammukdashin (hanaatan lahekdesh), nimkarin baitliz (venishchatin baitliz) venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser, shehanayatan labbealim. pesule hammukdashin hanayatan lahekdesh. veshoklin mane cheneged mane babbechor:
5.2: Vet shammay omrim, lo yimmana yisrael im hakkohen al habbechor. bet hillel mattirin, vaafillu nachri. bechor sheachazo dam, afillu hu met, en makkizin lo dam, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, yakkiz, uvilvad shello yaase vo mum. veim asa vo mum, hare ze lo yishshachet alav. rabbi shimon omer yakkiz, af al pi shehu ose vo mum:
5.3: Hatztzorem beozen habbechor, hare ze lo yishshachet olamit, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, kesheyyivvaled lo mum acher, yishshachet alav. maase vezachar shel rechelim zaken usearo meduldal, raahu kasdor echad, amar, ma tivo shel ze. amru lo, bechor hu veeno nishchat ella im ken haya bo mum. natal pigyon vetzaram beazno, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu. raa shehittiru, vehalach vetzaram beazne vechorot acherim, veasaru. paam achat hayu tinokot mesachakin bassade vekashru zanvot telaim ze laze, venifseka zenavo shel echad mehem vahare hu vechor, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu. rau shehittiru, vehalchu vekashru zanvot bechorot acherim, veasaru. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ledato, asur. veshello ledato, muttar:
5.4: Haya vechor rodfo, uveato veasa vo mum, hare ze yishchot alav. kol hammumin haruyin lavo vide adam, roim yisrael neemanim, veroim kohanim enan neemanim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, neeman hu al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo. rabbi meir omer, hechashud al davar, lo dano velo meido:
5.5: Neeman hakkohen lomar hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu. hakkol neemanim al mume hammaaser. bechor shennismet eno, shenniktea yado, shennishbera raglo, hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha vene hakkeneset, rabbi yose omer, afillu yesh sham esrim ushelosha, lo yishshachet ella al pi mumche:
5.6: Hashshochet et habbechor (umecharo) venoda shello herahu, ma sheachlu achlu vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. uma shello achlu, habbasar yikkaver vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. vechen hashshochet et happara umecharah venoda shehi terefa, ma sheachlu achlu veyachazir lahem et haddamim. uma shello achlu, hen yachaziru lo et habbasar vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. mecharuhu lannachrim o hittiluhu lakkelavim, yeshallemu lo deme hatterefa:

6.1: Al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, nifgema azno min hassechus, aval lo min haor, nisdeka af al pi shello chasra, nikkeva melo charshina, o sheyyavasha. ezo hi yevesha, kol shettinnakev veenah motzia tippat dam. rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, yevesha, shettehe nifrachet:
6.2: Ris shel ayin shennikkav, shennifgam, shennisdak, hare veenav dak, tevallul, chillazon nachash, veenav. veezehu tevallul, lavan hafosek bassira venichnas bashshachor. bashshachor venichnas ballavan, eno mum, sheen mumim ballavan:
6.3: Chavarvad vehammayim hakkevuim. ezehu chavarvad hakkavua, kol sheshshaha shemonim yom. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, bodkin oto shelosha feamim betoch shemonim yom. veellu hem mayim hakkevuim, achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim, lach veyavesh shel shelachim. achal hayyavesh veachar kach achal hallach, eno mum, ad sheyyochal hayyavesh achar hallach:
6.4: Chatmo shennikkav, shennifgam, shennisdak, sefato shennikkeva, shennifgema, shennisdeka, chittav hachitzonot shennifgemu o shennigmemu, vehafenimiyyot shenneekaru. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, en bodkin min hammatimot velifnim, af lo et hamatimot:
6.5: Nifgam hazzovan, o erya shel nekebba bammukdashim, nifgam hazzanav min haetzem, aval lo min happerek, o shehaya rosh hazzanav maftzil etzem, o sheyyesh (basar) ben chulya lechulya melo etzba:
6.6: En lo vetzim, (o) en lo ella betza echat. rabbi yishmael omer, im yesh lo shene chisin, yesh lo shete vetzim. en lo ella chis echad, en lo ella vetza echat. rabbi akiva omer, moshivo al akkuzo umemaech, im yesh sham betza, sofah latzet. maase shemmiech velo yatzat, venishchat venimtzet devuka bakkesalim, vehittir rabbi akiva veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri:
6.7: Baal chamesh raglayim, o sheen lo ella shalosh, vesheraglav kelutot keshel chamor, vehashshachul, vehakkasul. ezehu shachul, shennishmeta yerecho. vechasul, sheachat miyyarchotav gevoha:
6.8: Nishbar etzem yado, veetzem raglo, af al pi sheeno nikkar. mumin ellu mana ila veyavne, vehodu lo chachamim. veod shelosha hosif. amru lo, lo shamanu et ellu. et sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam, ufiv dome leshel chazir, veshennittal rov hamedabber shel leshono. uvet din shel acharehen amru, hare ellu mumin:
6.9: Maase shehallechi hattachton odef al haelyon, veshalach rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim veamru, hare ze mum. ozen haggedi shehayta chefula, amru chachamim, bizman shehi etzem echad, mum. veim enah etzem echad, enah mum. rabbi chananya ven gamliel omer, zenav haggedi shehi doma leshel chazir, vesheen bah shalosh chulyot, hare ze mum:
6.10: Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, et sheyyabbelet beeno, veshennifgam etzem yado, veetzem raglo, veshennifsak atzmo shebbefiv. eno achat gedola veachat ketanna, azno achat gedola veachat ketanna, bemare aval lo vemidda. rabbi yehuda omer, achat mibbetzav gedola kishtayim bachavertah, velo hodu lo chachamim:
6.11: Zenav haegel sheenah maggaat laarkov, amru chachamim, kol marbit haagalim ken, kol zeman shehen magdilin hem nimtachot. leeze arkov amru, rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, laarkov shebbeemtza hayyarech. al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, ufesule hammukdashin nifdin alehen:
6.12: Ellu sheen shochatin alehen lo vammikdash velo vammedina, chavarvad vehammayim sheenam kevuin, vechittav happenimiyyot shennifgemu, (aval lo) shenneekru, uvaal garav, uvaal yabbelet, uvaal chazazit, vezaken, vechole, umezuham, veshenneevda vo avera, veshehemit et haadam (al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim), vetumtum, veanderoginos, lo vammikdash velo vammedina. rabbi yishmael omer, en mum gadol mizze. vachachamim omrim, eno vechor, ella nigzaz veneevad:

7.1: Mumin ellu, ben kevuin ben ovrin, poslin baadam. yoter alehen baadam, hakkilon, vehallaftan, hammakkavan, vesherosho shakua, ushekifas. uvaale hachatoteret, rabbi yehuda machshir, vachachamim poslin:
7.2: Hakkereach, pasul. ezehu kereach, kol sheen lo shitta shel sear makkefet meozen leozen. veim yesh lo, hare ze kasher. en lo gebinim, en lo ella gevin echad, hu gibben haamur battora. rabbi dosa omer, kol sheggebinav shochvin. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, kol sheyyesh lo shene gabbim ushete shidraot:
7.3: Hecharum, pasul. ezehu charum, hakkochel shete enav keechat. shete enav lemala, ushete enav lematta, eno achat lemala, veeno achat lematta, roe et hacheder veet haaliyya keechat, sache shemesh, zugedos, vehatztziran. veshennashru rise enav, pasul, mippene marit haayin:
7.4: Enav gedolot keshel egel, o ketannot keshel avvaz, gufo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav, chatmo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav, hatztzimmem, vehatztzimmea. eze hu tzimmea, sheaznav ketannot. vehatztzimmem, sheaznav domot lisfog:
7.5: Sefato haelyona odefet al hattachtona, vehattachtona odefet al haelyona, hare ze mum. veshennittelu shinnav, pasul, mippene marit haayin. daddav shochvim keshel ishsha, kereso tzava, tabburo yotze, nichpe afillu achat leyamim, ruach katzrit baa alav, hameushkan, uvaal gever. en lo vetzim, o en lo ella vetza achat, zehu meroach ashech haamur battora. rabbi yishmael omer, kol shennimrechu ashachav. rabbi akiva omer, kol sheruach baashachav. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, kol shemmarav chashuchin:
7.6: Hammakkish bekarsullav, uvearkuvotav, uvaal pika, vehaikkel. ezehu ikkel, kol shemmakkif parsotav veen arkuvotav noshkot zo lazo. pika yotza miggudalo, akevo yotze laachorav, parsato rechava keshel avvaz. etzbeotav murkavot zo al zo, o kelutot (lemala) ad happerek, kasher. lematta min happerek vachatachah, kasher. hayta vo yeteret vachatachah, im yesh bah etzem, pasul. veim lav, kasher. yater beyadav uveraglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba, rabbi yehuda machshir, vachachamim poslim. hashsholet bishte yadav, rabbi posel, vachachamim machshirim. hakkushi, vehaggichor, vehallavkan, vehakkippeach, vehannannas, vehacheresh, vehashshote, vehashshikkor, uvaale negaim tehorin, pesulin baadam, uchesherin babbehema. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shota vabbehema enah min hammuvchar, rabbi eliezer omer, af baale dildulin, pesulin baadam, uchesherin babbehema:
7.7: Ellu kesherin baadam, ufesulin babbehema, oto veet beno, uterefa, veyotze dofen, (veshenneevda vahen avera, veshehemit et haadam). hannose nashim baavera, pasul, ad sheyyaddir hanaya. hammittamme lammetim, pasul, ad sheyyekabbel alav shello yehe mittamme lammetim:

8.1: Yesh bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen, bechor lakkohen veeno vechor lannachala, bechor lannachala velakkohen, yesh sheeno vechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen. ezehu bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen, habba achar hannefalim sheyyatza rosho chay, uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met, vehammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe vo mitztzurat haadam. hammappelet sandal, o shilya, ushefir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach, habba acharehen, bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen. mi shello hayu lo vanim venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda, odah shifcha venishtachrera, odah nachrit venitgayyera, mishshebbat leyishrael yalda, bechor lannachala veeno vechor lakkohen. rabbi yose haggelili omer, bechor lannachala velakkohen, shenneemar (Shemot 13), peter kol rechem bivne yisrael, ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael. mi shehayu lo vanim venasa ishsha shelo yalda, nitgayyera meubberet, nishtachrera meubberet, yalda hi vechohenet, hi uleviyya, hi veishsha shekkevar yalda, vechen mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon, o ven shiva laacharon, bechor lakkohen veeno vechor lannachala. ezehu bechor lannachala velakkohen, hammappelet shefir male dam, male mayim, male geninim, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim uremasim, hammappelet yom arbaim, habba acharehen, bechor lannachala velakkohen:
8.2: Yotze dofen vehabba acharav, shenehem enan bechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen. rabbi shimon omer, harishon lannachala, vehashsheni lechamesh selaim:
8.3: Mi shello vikkera ishto veyalda shene zecharim, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, haav patur. met haav vehabbanim kayyamim, rabbi meir omer, im natnu ad shello chalku, natanu. veim lav, peturin. rabbi yehuda omer nitchayyevu nechasim. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:
8.4: Shete nashim shello vikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim, noten eser selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, im lechohen echad natan, yachazir lo chamesh selaim. im lishne chohanim natan, eno yachol lehotzi miyyadam. zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum. achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim. noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, haav patur. met haav vehabbanim kayyamin, rabbi meir omer, im natnu ad shello chalku, natanu. veim lav, peturin. rabbi yehuda omer, nitchayyevu nechasim. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum:
8.5: Shete nashim shel shene anashim shello vikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim, ze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen, veze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, im lechohen echad natnu, yachazir lahen chamesh selaim. im lishne chohanim natnu, enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadam. zachar unekeva, haavot peturin, vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum:
8.6: Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera shel shene anashim, veyaldu shene zecharim, ze shello vikkera ishto, noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. zachar unekeva, en kan lakkohen kelum. met habben betoch sheloshim yom, af al pi shennatan lakkohen, yachazir (lo chamesh selaim). leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shello natan, yitten. met beyom sheloshim, keyom shellefanav. rabbi akiva omer, im natan, lo yittol. veim lo natan, lo yitten. met haav betoch sheloshim yom, bechezkat shello nifda, ad sheyyavi reaya shennifda. leachar sheloshim yom, bechezikat shennifda, ad (sheyyavi reaya) shello nifda. hu lippadot uveno lippadot, hu kodem et beno. rabbi yehuda omer, beno kodmo, shemmitzvato al aviv, umitzvat beno alav:
8.7: Chamesh selaim shel ben, bemane tzori. sheloshim shel eved, vachamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte, umea shel motzi shem ra, kullam beshekel hakkodesh, bemane tzori. vechullan nifdin bechesef, uveshave chesef, chutz min hashshekalim:
8.8: En podin lo vaavadim, velo vishtarot, velo vekarkaot, velo vehekdeshot. katav lakkohen shehu chayyav lo chamesh selaim, chayyav litten lo uveno eno faduy, lefichach im ratza hakkohen litten lo mattana, rashshay. hammafrish pidyon beno veavad, chayyav beacharayuto, shenneemar (Bamidbar 18), yihye lach ufado tifde:
8.9: Habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haav, veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem. veeno notel pi shenayim bashshevach, velo varauy kevammuchzak. velo haishsha bichtubbatah, velo habbanot bimzonotehen, velo hayyavam. vechullan en notlin bashshevach, velo varauy kevammuchzak:
8.10: Ellu sheenan chozrin bayyovel, habbechora, vehayyoresh et ishto, vehameyabbem et eshet achiv, vehammattana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mattana kemecher. rabbi eliezer omer, kullan chozrin bayyovel. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, hayyoresh et ishto, yachazir livne mishpacha vinakke lahem min haddamim:

9.1: Masar behema noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit, bachullin aval lo vammukdashin. venoheg babbakar uvatztzon, veenan mitasserim mizze al ze. bakkevasim uvaizzim, umitasserin mizze al ze. bechadash, uvayyashan, veenan mitasserin mizze al ze. shehaya baddin, ma im hechadash vehayyashan sheenan kilayim ze vaze, en mitasserin mizze al ze. hakkevasim vehaizzim shehem kilayim ze vaze, eno din shello yitasseru mizze al ze, talmud lomar (Vayikra 27), vatzon, mishma kol tzon, echad:
9.2: Masar behema mitztaref kimlo regel behema roa. vechamma hi regel behema roa, shishsha asar mil. haya ben ellu leellu sheloshim ushenayim mil, enan mitztarfin. haya lo vaemtza, mevi umeasseran baemtza. rabbi meir omer, hayyarden mafsik lemasar behema:
9.3: Hallakuach o shennittan lo mattana, patur mimmasar behema. haachim hashshuttafin shechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmasar behema. veshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. kanu mittefusat habbayit, chayyavin. veim lav, peturin. chalku vechazru venishtattefu, chayyabbin bakkalbon ufeturin mimmasar behema:
9.4: Hakkol nichnas laddir lehitasser, chutz min hakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, umechussar zeman, veyatom. ezehu yatom, kol shemmeta immo o shennishchata. rabbi yehoshua omer, afillu nishchata immo vehashshelach kayyam, en ze yatom:
9.5: Shalosh geranot lemasar behema, bifros happesach, bifros haatzeret, bifros hechag, divre rabbi akiva. ben azzay omer, beesrim vetisha baadar, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha veav. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim, beechad benisan, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha veelul. velamma amru beesrim vetisha veelul velo amru beechad betishre, mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov, lefichach hikdimuhu beesrim vetisha veelul. rabbi meir omer, beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. ben azzay omer, haeluliyyin mitasserin bifne atzman:
9.6: Kol hannoladim meechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul, hare ellu mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne rosh hashshana vachamishsha leachar rosh hashshana, enan mitztarfin. chamishsha lifne haggoren vachamishsha leachar haggoren, hare ellu mitztarfin. im ken lamma neemar shalosh geranot lemasar behema, shead shello higgia haggoren, muttar limkor velishchot. higgia haggoren, lo yishchot. veim shachat, patur:
9.7: Ketzad measseran, konsan laddir veose lahen petach katan kede shello yihyu shenayim yecholin latzet keachat, umone vashshevet, echad, shenayim, shelosha, arbaa, chamishsha, shishsha, shiva, shemona, tisha, vehayotze asiri sokro vesikra veomer hare ze maaser. lo sekaro vesikra velo menaam bashshevet, o shemmenaam revutzim, o omdim, hare ellu meussarim, haya lo mea venatal asara, asara venatal echad, en ze maaser. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, hare ze maaser, kafatz (echad) min hammenuyin letochan, hare ellu feturin. min hameussarim letochan, kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu vemuman labbealim:
9.8: Yatzu shenayim keechad, mone otan shenayim shenayim. menaan echad, teshii vaasiri mekulkalin. yatzu teshii vaasiri keachat, teshii vaasiri mekulkalin. kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii uleachad asar asiri, shelashtan mekuddashin. hatteshii neechol bemumo, vehaasiri maaser, veachad asar karev shelamim veose temura, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yehuda, vechi yesh temura osa temura. amru mishshum rabbi meir, illu haya temura, lo haya karev. kara latteshii asiri velaasiri asiri uleachad asar asiri, en achad asar mekuddash. ze hakkelal, kol shello neekar shem asiri mimmennu, en achad asar mekuddash:
